_comment: Example serving registry (portable schema, PLACEHOLDER paths). Copy to a real file OUTSIDE git (e.g. datasets_dryrun/serving_datasets.json, which is gitignored), fill in the actual paths for your deployment, then: export PROTORCD_SERVING_CONFIG=/abs/path/to/your.json && uvicorn serving.server:app. The client only ever sends the logical dataset NAME; it never sees these paths.

datasets._comment: Single-split dataset: one feature-store dir per representation, one COCO (optional, for offline-GT labels/calibration), one image_root for crops.
datasets.name: DATASET_A

datasets._comment: Pooled multi-split dataset (e.g. train+test). List each split's feature store and COCO in order; split_tags names the splits. Because each split's proposal file_names are relative to a DIFFERENT image tree, use image_roots keyed by split tag (not a single image_root).
datasets.name: DATASET_B
